name: Vasara
description:
Vasara gives Claude direct access to Lithuania's primary legal sources – with citations it can verify.

Search national legislation, EU regulations and directives, and case law from the Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, the CJEU, and the ECtHR. Look up a decision by case number, search by topic, pull specific passages from long documents, or check guidance from state authorities and municipalities.

Read-only – doesn't create, edit, or submit anything. Requires a free or paid Vasara account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vasara to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vasara to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vasara.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vasara MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vasara lists 21 MCP tools, including get-court-case-by-case-number, get-legal-research-instructions, search-case-law, search-chunks-from-court-case-by-number, search-chunks-from-document-by-id, search-chunks-from-document-by-title, search-echr-judgments, search-laws, search-legal-acts, search-legal-sources, search-municipalities-documents, and search-organization-documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vasara?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vasara in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Vasara requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vasara is developed by Vasara. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
